hook: A relay that holds itself, drawn in a few clicks.
pick: The relay's part knows its contacts. Pick the free one, and click it into the page.
wires: Two wires put it in parallel to the start button. Now the relay holds itself, until Stop opens the circuit.
image: It is contact 13, 14 of K 1 by itself, and the coil lists where it is used.
end: Open E Craft. Free, open source, and it runs in your browser.
